narrative: A paper plot hangs on a nail by the parlour door in the yard. The columns are entrances. A stool with a book stands under it. No face. The book on the stool, open at Costard's pages. The margin has a pin and no strokes. Rain is on the sill. No hand. A watchet gown on a hook beside the plot, sleeves long, the hem dark from the yard. It is not yet on a body.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the plot and the blank margin, and did not take the gown down.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Was at the stool with the book, and is not heard in this look.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on plot in The plot on the nail
